ideas.pitch: AI-powered incident forecasting and community risk mapping dashboard specifically tailored for urban campus safety in New Brunswick.
ideas.title: SafetyNet-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact winning pattern of ai-incident-forecasting by combining statistical prediction models with geospatial mapping to solve a localized, high-impact problem.

ideas.pitch: Personalized AI nutrition and budget meal planning platform optimized for college dining halls and local grocery stores in New Brunswick.
ideas.title: NutriCampus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven winning blueprint of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant by targeting an audience familiar to the judges—college students—with practical utility.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student support and carbon footprint tracking platform for university sustainability initiatives in New Jersey.
ideas.title: EcoScore-NJ
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning strategy of greennovation-ai-platform by combining multi-agent architecture with localized environmental impact tracking.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous student marketplace using decentralized escrow payments for textbook and dorm furniture exchanges on New Brunswick campuses.
ideas.title: LocalMarket-Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the transactional and escrow mechanics that won the Synthesis Hackathon into a closed-loop ecosystem designed for university students.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered patient onboarding and trust-building platform designed for student health services and local university clinics.
ideas.title: ClinicTrust-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the healthcare acquisition engine that won Prize Hackathon by addressing a concrete operational friction point in patient intake.
